targets.authors: Maritz, A., Jones, C. & Shwetzer, C.
targets.title: The status of entrepreneurship education in Australian universities
targets.evidence_quote: This study is in essence a replication and extension study. It is a replication of the Maritz et al (2015) study of the status of entrepreneurship education in Australia, and an extension from a point of view of recency of developments and initiatives in EE (QAA, 2018;Nabi et al., 2017;Neck & Corbett, 2018;Kuratko & Morris, 2018;OECD/EU, 2018;Morris et al., 2013;Maritz, 2017), coupled with examination of the latest EEP and entrepreneurship offerings at Australian HEI.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors compare updated programme and subject counts with 2014 counts to document change. They do not adjudicate whether the original finding is confirmed or contradicted; near-identical programme totals and reduced subject totals alone do not establish a replication verdict.

reasoning: Updated data from Australian HEI websites repeat the earlier published survey and explicitly compare counts. Other cited EE frameworks are background or extensions, not targets. Cache lacks a title page/provenance header; identity checked against publisher title, authors and methods.
